quality_notes: UK Methane Action Plan mixes inventory-derived historical values, forecasts and policy contributions; each is explicitly labelled and none is parcel-bound.
Decarbonisation-readiness evidence records permitting thresholds and future-readiness tests, not realised emissions reductions.
F-gas/ODS evidence records statutory registry, reporting and charging rules; monetary charges are not emissions quantities.
Landfill methane measurement source was detected as already canonical in Wave91 and was not duplicated.
